items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I bought him out. He never would forget me.

ctx.x: I bought him out. He never would forget me. If he got a little three or four piece jar, he'd come lick me up, come and get me, and we'd all play together. Bandra and guitar, you know. And he would sing, you know.
Ask him who he was playing with when the big storm came.
